tasks.title: Photoperiodism
tasks.instruction: Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
tasks.translation: 植物和动物对阳光和季节变化的反应（称为光周期或季节性）对许多生物和行为过程至关重要。光周期与温度变化一起影响季节性迁徙、交配仪式和冬眠。对许多鸟类来说，激素水平在春季会增加，这会导致雄性鸣叫频率和交配行为增加。光周期使植物和动物能够对与季节变化和白天长度变化相关的环境变化做出反应。

passage.t: The reaction of plants and animals to sunlight and seasonal changes, known as photoperiodism or seasonality, is vital to many biological and behavioral processes. Photoperiods,

, which leads to an increase in singing frequency in males and mating behaviors. Photoperiodism allows plants and animals to respond to changes in the environment associated with changing seasons and varying day length.

layout.title: FitLife Gym Membership
layout.body:
Monthly plans cost $30 with equipment access only.
Quarterly ($80) adds group classes and swimming pool privileges.
Annual members ($300) receive personal training discounts plus guest passes.
New members get a one-week free trial but must commit to a minimum three-month membership afterward.

questions.stem: What benefits does a quarterly member have that a monthly member lacks?
questions.analysis: 月卡只有器械使用；季卡增加团体课和游泳池权益。

questions.stem: What is required of new members after the one-week free trial ends?
questions.analysis: 免费试用结束后，新会员必须承诺至少三个月的会籍。

tasks.title: Formation of Sedimentary Rocks
tasks.translation: 沉积岩通过矿物颗粒、有机物和化学沉淀物的沉积、压实和胶结形成。这些沉积物常在河流、湖泊和海洋等水体中层层堆积。上层沉积物的重量加压，使下层体积缩小并把水排出，这一过程称为压实。胶结发生在溶解矿物离开地下水并填充压实颗粒之间的空隙、将它们黏合在一起时。这两个过程合称石化作用，把松散沉积物变成坚硬岩石。沉积岩分为碎屑岩、化学岩和有机岩三类。碎屑岩如砂岩和页岩由先前岩石的碎片组成；化学岩如石灰岩和石膏由水中析出的溶解矿物形成；有机岩如煤由动植物残体堆积并石化而成。研究沉积岩有助于了解地球历史。这些岩石常含化石，即古代生物的保存遗骸。化石能揭示过去的环境、气候条件和演化过程。此外，沉积岩的层理还能指示火山喷发或海平面变化等重大地质事件。
paras: Sedimentary rocks form through deposition, compaction, and cementation of materials like mineral particles, organic matter, and chemical precipitates. These sediments accumulate in layers, often in bodies of water like rivers, lakes, and oceans. As layers are deposited, the weight of the overlying layers exerts pressure on the sediments below, reducing their volume and ejecting water, a process known as compaction. Cementation occurs when dissolved minerals leave groundwater and fill the spaces between compacted particles, binding them together. This dual process is called lithification, transforming loose sediments into solid rock.

Sedimentary rocks are classified into three primary categories: clastic, chemical, and organic. Clastic sedimentary rocks, such as sandstone and shale, are composed of fragments of preexisting rocks. Chemical sedimentary rocks, including limestone and gypsum, form from dissolved minerals leaching out of water. Organic sedimentary rocks, like coal, develop from the accumulation and lithification of plant and animal matter.

The study of sedimentary rocks offers insights into Earth's history. These rocks often contain fossils, the preserved remains of ancient organisms. Fossils can reveal much about past environments, climate conditions, and evolutionary processes. Additionally, the layering of sedimentary rocks can indicate significant geological events, such as volcanic eruptions or changes in sea level.

questions.stem: The word "ejecting" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 上层沉积物的重量加压，使下层体积缩小并把水排出，因此 ejecting 是 forcing out（强行排出）。

questions.stem: According to the passage, lithification includes which two processes?
questions.analysis: This dual process is called lithification，指 compaction 与 cementation。

questions.stem: How do chemical sedimentary rocks such as limestone form?

options.B: From the remains of plants and animals
options.C: From dissolved minerals leaching out of water
options.D: From pressure created by volcanic eruptions

questions.analysis: Chemical sedimentary rocks ... form from dissolved minerals leaching out of water。

questions.stem: What can fossils in sedimentary rocks reveal?

options.A: The exact age of every mineral particle
options.D: Why oceans no longer produce sediments

questions.analysis: Fossils can reveal much about past environments, climate conditions, and evolutionary processes。

questions.stem: What can the layering of sedimentary rocks indicate?

options.A: That compaction never occurs in oceans
options.B: That chemical rocks cannot contain fossils
options.C: That all sedimentary rocks form on dry land
options.D: Significant geological events such as eruptions or sea-level change

questions.analysis: the layering of sedimentary rocks can indicate significant geological events, such as volcanic eruptions or changes in sea level。
